tasks.subject: Task 1: Core/CsWarp.js -- MLS deformation, pure and tested
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pure function that warps one point given a set of old->new control-point pairs, using inverse-square-distance-weighted Moving Least Squares similarity, with node-level tests proving it reproduces control points exactly, matches the existing rigid fit when the data truly is rigid, and blends smoothly across a genuinely non-rigid case.

**Files:**
- Create: scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsWarp.js
- Test: tests/js_unit.js (new block inserted right after the existing pure CsTrace block ending at line 13931 with `}());`, before the `// CsTrace -- the point-to-frame region test` comment)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] CsWarp.mlsSimilarity(point, controlPairs) returns null for 0 pairs, a pure translation for 1 pair, {x,y,angle,factor} for 2+
- [ ] A point at a control pair's old position warps to within 1e-6 of its nu position, regardless of other pairs
- [ ] Matches CsRevise.applyFit(CsRevise.similarityFit(pairs), point) to within 1e-9 for genuinely rigid data (2-pair and 4-pair cases)
- [ ] A genuinely non-rigid two-cluster case produces different output near each cluster and a smooth blend between them
- [ ] node tests/js_unit.js passes with the new assertions counted

**Verify:** node tests/js_unit.js -> ### UNIT OK <N> assertions, N greater than pre-task count

**Steps:** Full CsWarp.js source and full js_unit.js test block are written out verbatim in the plan doc (Task 1, Steps 1-2) -- copy them exactly, run node tests/js_unit.js, commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsWarp.js", "tests/js_unit.js"], "verifyCommand": "node tests/js_unit.js", "acceptanceCriteria": ["mlsSimilarity handles 0/1/2+ pair cases correctly", "exact reproduction at control points within 1e-6", "matches similarityFit exactly for rigid data within 1e-9", "non-rigid two-cluster case blends smoothly", "node tests/js_unit.js reports UNIT OK"], "modelTier": "standard"}

tasks.subject: Task 2: CsRevise.moveLinework -- per-vertex warp dispatch
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace the whole-entity rigid-fit-or-refuse step with per-vertex MLS warping for polyline, line, arc, circle and spline entities; everything else (blocks, text, ...) keeps today's behavior unchanged.

**Files:**
- Modify: scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsRevise.js:900-1065 (LINEWORK_RESIDUAL_FRACTION comment, moveLinework's docblock and body)
- Modify: scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsAll.js (add CsWarp.js to the include list, right before CsRevise.js at line 89)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Polyline: every vertex warped individually via getVertexAt/countVertices + moveReferencePoint; bulges untouched
- [ ] Line: both endpoints warped individually
- [ ] Spline: every control point warped individually
- [ ] Arc/Circle: center warped via CsWarp.mlsSimilarity, radius scaled by that call's local factor
- [ ] Any other entity type keeps the EXACT unchanged rigid-fit-with-refusal path; CsRevise.LINEWORK_RESIDUAL_FRACTION still exists, now scoped to only that fallback
- [ ] result gains a `warped` counter (moved vs warped are mutually exclusive); only 0-control-point entities land in unmoved
- [ ] node tests/js_unit.js still passes unchanged (moveLinework itself is engine-only, invisible to node)

**Verify:** node tests/js_unit.js -> ### UNIT OK <N> assertions, same N as after Task 1

**Steps:** Full replacement text for the constant's comment, moveLinework's docblock, and its entire body are written out verbatim in the plan doc (Task 2, Steps 1-3), plus the CsAll.js include line (Step 4). Copy exactly, run node tests/js_unit.js and the structural test suite, commit.

tasks.subject: Task 4: Engine-only integration test + run_all.sh wiring
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the whole pipeline against REAL RDocument/RPolylineEntity/RLineEntity/RArcEntity/RCircleEntity/RSplineEntity/RTextEntity objects inside the actual CaveCAD engine, and wire it into tests/run_all.sh.

**Files:**
- Create: tests/linework_warp.js
- Modify: tests/run_all.sh (new numbered step, renumber existing 9 steps' N/9 labels to N/10)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] A 3-vertex polyline near 3 non-rigidly-moving stations ends up with each vertex independently matching CsWarp.mlsSimilarity's own prediction -- not a single whole-entity transform
- [ ] The polyline's bulge is numerically unchanged after the move
- [ ] Line/arc/circle/spline bound to the same stations all move/warp without throwing; arc/circle radius scales by a measurably different amount than a rigid move would (proves local factor used, not 1.0)
- [ ] A text entity bound to stations that moved far from rigid still lands in unmoved -- unchanged old refusal behavior
- [ ] moveLinework's returned {moved, warped, unmoved} counts match the test setup exactly (1 warped, 4 moved, 1 unmoved)
- [ ] lineworkSummary's output text contains "warped to follow a bend" when called with these counts
- [ ] tests/run_all.sh runs this file as a new step and fails the whole run if it fails

**Verify:** "$QCAD" -no-dock-icon -no-gui -allow-multiple-instances -autostart tests/linework_warp.js "$PWD" -> ### LINEWORK WARP OK; then bash tests/run_all.sh -> ALL TESTS PASSED including the new step

**Steps:** Full tests/linework_warp.js source is written out verbatim in the plan doc (Task 4, Step 1), plus the exact run_all.sh insertion (Step 3, after renumbering the 9 existing N/9 labels to N/10). Copy exactly, run standalone against the installed CaveCAD, then run the whole suite, commit.

```
